notes.title: What’s New in v1.1.0
notes.content:
This minor update brings polish, new content, and enhancements based on your valuable feedback, here's what's new:

 Puzzle Tuning – Rebalanced several mid- and late-game levels for better pacing, difficulty progression, and solution clarity.
 Visual Polish – Improved lighting, block materials, and background animations across all environments for a more immersive 3D experience.
 UI & UX Improvements – Streamlined menus and in-game interface for better usability.
 Bug Fixes & Optimization – Fixed reported issues with block clipping, save data inconsistencies, and improved performance on low-end hardware.
